product_action: No product promotion. C-FRESHNESS remains EXPERIMENTAL bounded to localhost stochastic mock. Parallel-channel architecture (behavioral + structural) justified only at this mock ceiling. Production gate remains open.

reason: The frozen decision rule passes all five conditions: C1 positive control 0.8333, C2 TP=1.0 at calibrated threshold 0.20, C3 orthogonality r=-0.0065 CI upper 0.0831 < 0.15, C4 FP=0.0, C5 TOST PASS. The continuous severity injection resolves the parent's V-THRESHOLD-TAUTOLOGY by introducing discriminating TP decline (gradual 1.00→0.78 vs parent flat 1.0) and confirms error_format_variation is now effective (4/4 noise types). However, the audit correctly identifies that the calibrated threshold 0.20 is a low-edge optimum forced by designed separation (noise 0.05-0.14 vs failure 0.20-0.39), not a middle-range discriminating operating point. The FP constraint is never binding, meaning this experiment does not test whether the behavioral signal can discriminate in the presence of overlapping noise/refresh distributions as would occur in production. The mock-to-production gap remains the sole bottleneck. Six structural signal families remain falsified. C-FRESHNESS cannot advance to VALIDATED or PRODUCT_CORE without production substrate testing with overlapping distributions.
